hypothesis: New exact-station filters can discard direct trains serving other stations within the city represented by a city query code. Source proves raw telecode equality; native city query expansion and service availability still require observation.
date_policy: Call Early get-current-date once; parse returned Shanghai YYYY-MM-DD and use plus3 calendar days for all ticket calls. Do not choose dates/routes after outcomes.
station_policy: Each stage calls get-station-code-of-citys with 天津|济南 and uses the returned station_code strings. No hardcoded codes or benchmark task locations.
stop_rules: No retries, no route/date replacement, no model calls.

If server initialization/catalog/date/code/default-ticket readiness fails or default response is empty/non-JSON/error, retain evidence and stop remaining stages/calls; no proven available task mechanism.
Exact-filter failures are evidence: save them and complete the other planned exact-filter call if the native session remains live.
If interruption occurs, never restart completed calls; inspect saved observations/handle and preregister only remaining work if warranted.

acceptance.mechanism: All planned default responses are real nonempty ticket lists; at least one returned direct train has origin/destination telecodes differing from the representative city code; exact filters remove those trains, consistent with source equality. Show retained/dropped identities, not only counts.
acceptance.source_equivalence: Compare actual train identity/station/time fields across same-stage live queries; ticket availability may change. Nonequivalence limits inference, never deletes/retries evidence.
acceptance.not_sufficient: Native filter loss alone is not completion or quality improvement. No agent experiment is authorized by this probe result without a separate frozen strategy/rubric/schedule.
acceptance.exclusions: No booking, purchase, cloud deployment, publication, credentials or task reference answers. Only public native read queries.
